name: Ultimate Metro (Prototype)
summary: Experimental surface tram terminus. Native reversal is not yet proven; test saves only.
description: Private prototype revision 6: two-track surface tram terminus with scissors crossover and explicit reverse-direction lanes over the same physical tracks. Native probes in revision 5 accepted inbound paths but rejected reverse traversal of the same edges, despite forwardOnly=false. This version supplies actual opposite geometry. Native routing, terminal reversal, crossing safety and passenger access remain unproven. Place two NEW crossover stations on a test save. One vehicle only. No hidden loop or vehicle commands. Internal rails and catenary visuals remain unfinished. Read-only diagnostics inspect both directions. Do not remove while constructions remain.
